description: This file provides utility classes, functions, and mock implementations for testing URLRequest components in the Chromium networking codebase. It includes mock delegates, context getters, test servers, and interceptors used for unit testing URL request handling.

classes.name: TestURLRequestContextGetter
classes.description: Provides a dummy URLRequestContext for testing, associated with a specific task runner.

classes.name: TestDelegate
classes.description: Implements URLRequest::Delegate for testing, capturing request events and states.

classes.name: TestNetworkDelegate
classes.description: Mocks network delegate behavior for testing network request handling.

classes.name: FilteringTestNetworkDelegate
classes.description: Extends TestNetworkDelegate with cookie filtering capabilities.

classes.name: HttpTestServer
classes.description: A simple embedded test server with default handlers for testing HTTP requests.

classes.name: TestScopedURLInterceptor
classes.description: Sets up a temporary URLRequestInterceptor for intercepting specific URL requests during tests.

methods.name: CreateTestURLRequestContextBuilder
methods.description: Creates and configures a URLRequestContextBuilder for testing purposes.

methods.name: URLRequestContextGetter::GetURLRequestContext
methods.description: Returns the URLRequestContext associated with this getter.

methods.name: URLRequestContextGetter::GetNetworkTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner used for network operations.

methods.name: TestDelegate::RunUntilComplete
methods.description: Runs the message loop until the request completes.

methods.name: TestDelegate::RunUntilAuthRequired
methods.description: Runs until an authentication challenge is required.
